Choose Pacific Blue Basic when bright white presentation and crisp embossed wet-pull release in mid-size office restrooms are priorities; choose Tork Universal when 100% recycled EcoLogo/Green Seal documentation is mandated by a LEED lease, or upgrade busy washrooms to universal/touchless roll dispensers to beat the $0.012 to $0.025 per sq ft per visit contractor supply markup.

blocks.text: Comparing the Two Heavyweights of 4,000-Count Office Multifold Towels

When a commercial property manager or office operations lead sets up an Amazon Business auto-delivery schedule for folded restroom and breakroom paper towels, the comparison almost always narrows down to two industry benchmarks: Essity's Tork Universal Hand Towel Multifold (H2 system compatible) and Georgia-Pacific's Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case, formerly known across the janitorial trade as GP Acclaim). Both ship in master cartons containing 4,000 1-ply interfolded towels divided into 16 sleeves of 250 sheets.

At first glance on a spec sheet, their unfolded dimensions (roughly 9.13 to 9.2 inches wide by 9.4 to 9.5 inches long) and folded depth (3.25 inches) appear nearly identical. In practice, however, subtle differences in fiber furnish, embossing pattern, wet-tensile sizing, and sleeve rigidity determine how smoothly they feed through recessed stainless steel throat plates—and how much paper waste your night janitorial crew hauls out during $15 to $30 per restroom per visit or $12 to $25 per breakroom per visit sanitation rounds.

blocks.title: EPA CPG & LEED Building Lease Compliance
blocks.text: Both Tork Universal Multifold and Georgia-Pacific Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case) satisfy US EPA Comprehensive Procurement Guidelines (CPG) for minimum post-consumer recycled fiber content. If your office occupies a LEED-certified Class A building, maintaining the carton spec sheet on file satisfies the tenant green-consumables credit during annual property management audits.
Side-by-Side Technical Evaluation: Tork Universal H2 vs. Pacific Blue Basic

To decide which 4,000-count case fits your building's wall cabinets and occupant expectations across 4.33 weeks per month, examine how Tork Universal and Pacific Blue Basic differ across four operational dimensions:

items: Sheet Brightness & Visual Impression: Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case) are famous in commercial facility management for delivering a clean, consistent white appearance that looks intentional in professional law, accounting, tech, and medical offices. Tork Universal Multifold is produced in both natural Kraft (unbleached brown) and universal white variants; always verify brightness grade if your executive suite dislikes brown Kraft paper.

Embossing Texture & Wet-Tab Pull Resistance: Pacific Blue Basic uses Georgia-Pacific's signature diamond/honeycomb surface embossing, which gives the 1-ply sheet extra structural stiffness so the exposed 1.5-inch tab does not wilt or rip off when pinched by wet fingers. Tork Universal H2 multifold uses a softer crepe finish that feeds smoothly in wider-mouth Tork H2 plastic dispensers but can experience occasional tab-tearing in older, sharp-edged recessed stainless steel slots if overpacked.

Water Absorbency Rate (Sheets Per Dry): In controlled washroom trials, both 1-ply economy multifolds require 2.5 to 3.0 sheets for a full two-hand dry—meaning a 4,000-towel case yields approximately 1,350 to 1,600 hand dries regardless of brand.

When Neither Multifold Is Enough (High-Traffic Upgrade): If your office exceeds 50 employees per restroom or runs on a 2x-week (8.66 visits/mo, 1.00 multiplier) or 3x-week (13.0 visits/mo, 0.95 multiplier) cleaning contract where 400-sheet multifold cabinets run dry mid-shift, upgrading to the San Jamar Tear-N-Dry Essence Electronic Towel Dispenser (universal non-proprietary 8-inch roll) or the Georgia-Pacific enMotion 10-Inch Automated Touchless Paper Towel Dispenser lowers ongoing sheet usage by 25% to 35%.

blocks.text: Pairing Multifold Refills With Hybrid Roll and Tissue Hardware

For offices that retain recessed folded cabinets in secondary restrooms or breakrooms, stocking Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case) provides an immediate, reliable fit. The 16 individual 250-sheet packs store cleanly on janitor carts and feed consistently through standard 3.25-to-3.5-inch folded towel slots while meeting federal EPA recycled-fiber standards.

When a high-traffic restroom outgrows folded sleeves, you have two smart hardware upgrade paths depending on your procurement philosophy. If you want electronic touchless dispensing without being locked into a single paper brand's proprietary core, install the San Jamar Tear-N-Dry Essence Electronic Towel Dispenser. Powered by 4 D-cell batteries in a low-profile impact-resistant housing, the Tear-N-Dry Essence accepts any universal 8-inch commercial roll towel on the market and feeds a consistent 10-inch sheet with zero wait delay. Conversely, if you want executive Class A acoustics and wider TAD towels, specify the Georgia-Pacific enMotion 10-Inch Automated Touchless Paper Towel Dispenser, featuring whisper-quiet motor operation, programmable sheet lengths, and ADA depth compliance.

Complete your restroom and custodial closet standardization by mounting the Tork Twin Jumbo Bath Tissue Roll Dispenser T2 in your stalls—housing two 9-inch jumbo rolls with an integrated stub-roll gate that prevents premature roll changes—and equipping your night crew with Berry Rhino-X 38x60 Heavy-Duty 55-Gallon Liners (200-Case). Because discarded multifold paper towels create bulky, damp waste volumes, Berry Rhino-X's 17-micron leak-proof construction allows custodians to compress multiple restroom bins into a single 55-gallon collection barrel without rips or drips across commercial carpet (1.0x multiplier) or VCT vinyl corridors (1.04x multiplier).
4-Step Decision Protocol: Tork Multifold vs. Pacific Blue Basic vs. Roll Retrofit

items.name: Inspect the Dispenser Mouth Width and Lip Radius
items.text: If your existing wall cabinets are older recessed stainless steel units with a narrow, rigid slot, choose Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case) for its stiffer embossed wet-tab strength. If your walls have Tork H2 plastic surface cabinets, either Tork Universal or Pacific Blue Basic feeds effortlessly.

items.name: Check Your Lease for Natural vs. White Fiber Preferences
items.text: Verify whether your tenant improvements or ESG reporting require bleached white EPA-compliant paper (Pacific Blue Basic) or unbleached 100% recycled natural Kraft sheets.

items.name: Flag Any Cabinet That Runs Out Before Nightly Janitorial Visits
items.text: Track which cabinets require daytime office-manager refills between your 2x-week (8.66 visits/mo) or 3x-week (13.0 visits/mo) cleaning shifts, and retrofit those specific sinks with a San Jamar Tear-N-Dry Essence or enMotion 10-inch roll dispenser.

faqs.q: Are Georgia-Pacific Pacific Blue Basic folded towels the exact same product as the old GP Acclaim multifold towels?
faqs.a: Yes. Georgia-Pacific rebranded its commercial Acclaim and Envision folded towel lines under the Pacific Blue Basic family. Pacific Blue Basic Folded Paper Towels (4000-Case) maintain the exact same 9.2 x 9.4-inch unfolded sheet size, 3.25-inch folded depth, 16-pack x 250-sheet case count, and EPA recycled-content compliance that facility managers relied on with GP Acclaim.

faqs.q: Will Pacific Blue Basic multifold towels fit inside a Tork H2 multifold dispenser (and vice versa)?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike proprietary hard-roll systems that lock you out with notched plastic core plugs, standard H2/multifold cabinets use a universal 9.13-to-9.25-inch width by 3.25-inch folded depth cavity. Both Tork Universal Multifold and Pacific Blue Basic 4,000-count sleeves interchange directly in Tork H2, Georgia-Pacific Vista, San Jamar, and Bobrick recessed multifold cabinets.

faqs.q: Why should an office consider the San Jamar Tear-N-Dry Essence over a proprietary roll dispenser when upgrading from multifold?
faqs.a: The San Jamar Tear-N-Dry Essence Electronic Towel Dispenser accepts any non-proprietary universal 8-inch hard roll towel regardless of core diameter or brand. That gives procurement managers the touchless 10-inch single-sheet waste reduction of an automated roll dispenser while retaining the freedom to shop competitive bulk 8-inch roll cases just like they did with universal multifold paper.

faqs.q: How do we calculate monthly multifold case orders using the 4.33 weeks-per-month commercial janitorial standard?
faqs.a: Multiply your average daily in-office headcount by 3.2 hand-dry events per day, then multiply by 2.7 multifold sheets per dry and 21.65 workdays per month (5 workdays/week x 4.33 weeks/month). A 40-person office consumes roughly 7,480 multifold sheets per month—just under two 4,000-count cases per month.
